Sample: 3B

Score: 6 (1-0-0-0-1-1-1-1-1)

The response earned 6 points: 1 point in part A, 0 points in part B, 2 points in part C, and 3 points in part D.

In part A the response earned P1 with the correct answer of 5 with supporting work. Numerical simplification is not 

required. The response would have also earned the point with the expression 100

In part B the response did not earn P3 because there is no statement that R must be continuous because R is 
differentiable. The response did not earn P4. A response that does not state that R is continuous is not eligible to earn P4.
